summary: An external AI understood that new learning belongs in the USG Inbox but had to design the contribution workflow itself and did not complete the submission. The repository should expose a minimal deterministic agent contribution rule.
rationale: The repository already defines a permissive Inbox and a public contribution path. The gap is agent-facing discoverability and execution, not USG protocol semantics. Making the minimum valid contribution and stop condition explicit reduces host-AI orchestration without duplicating this logic in STAR-T-GATE.
provenance: Owner observation from Mis/Mistral contribution attempt on 2026-10-30
validation: Compared proposed behavior with existing public contribution rule: external contributors modify only inbox/**
Confirmed inbox metadata is already optional
Confirmed curator, not contributor, owns normalization, classification, testing and canonical promotion
No protocol version or stage behavior changed
